prompt: What is the effect of the following lines in `/etc/named.conf`: `listen-on port 53 { 127.0.0.1; };` `listen-on-v6 port 53 { ::1; };`?
choices: The server forwards all queries to `127.0.0.1`.
The server can only be accessed from the computer on which it is running.
The server disables IPv6 support entirely.
The server allows zone transfers only to `localhost`.
explanation: Binding only to the loopback addresses `127.0.0.1` and `::1` means the server is reachable only from the local machine.
